name: wayfinder-sidebar
description: A sidebar of your wayfinder map's tickets: ready, claimed and blocked, with buttons to open a ticket or start a session on it (optionally with a handoff from this session).

launcher.title: Where new sessions open
launcher.description: iterm opens a new iTerm tab, terminal a new Terminal.app window, copy puts the command on the clipboard.

editor.title: Editor for ticket files
editor.description: Command that opens a ticket .md file, for example code, cursor or zed. Empty uses the system default (open).

pollSeconds.title: Local refresh (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to check local ticket files for changes made by other sessions.

githubSeconds.title: GitHub refresh (seconds)
githubSeconds.description: How often to re-read GitHub maps.
